stories.title: Una explosión en un piso de Valdemoro deja grandes daños materiales y tres perros muertos

en.title: An explosion in a Valdemoro apartment causes major property damage and kills three dogs
en.summary: An explosion occurred in an apartment in Valdemoro, causing significant material damage. Emergency services rescued one dog from the rooftop, but three others died in the incident.

stories.title: Los médicos aplazan la huelga indefinida por el adelanto electoral

en.title: Doctors postpone indefinite strike due to early election call
en.summary: Medical organizations in Spain have cancelled an indefinite strike scheduled for October 28 following an early election announcement for November 29. The healthcare reform legislation at the center of the dispute will need to be reintroduced after the election.

stories.title: Los médicos posponen la huelga indefinida del 28 de octubre por la convocatoria electoral

en.title: Doctors postpone indefinite strike on October 28 due to election call
en.summary: Doctors have postponed an indefinite strike scheduled for October 28 following the announcement of early elections.

stories.title: Rodalies recupera parcialmente el servicio tras el plante de los maquinistas por la falta de seguridad

en.title: Rodalies partially restores service after train drivers' work action over safety concerns
en.summary: Rodalies commuter rail service has partially resumed on some lines after train operators refused to operate without adequate safety guarantees following days of weather disruptions. Multiple lines remain suspended.

stories.title: Aparatosa explosión de gas en un edificio nuevo de Valdemoro: mueren tres perros y otro resulta herido

en.title: Dramatic gas explosion in new building in Valdemoro: three dogs die and another is injured
en.summary: A gas explosion occurred in a new building in Valdemoro, resulting in the deaths of three dogs and injury to another. No people were affected by the blast.

stories.title: Una explosión provoca un incendio en una vivienda de Valdemoro y deja varios perros intoxicados

en.title: Explosion causes fire in Valdemoro home and leaves several dogs intoxicated
en.summary: An explosion at a residential property in Valdemoro on Wednesday morning triggered a fire, requiring firefighter response. Several dogs suffered intoxication from smoke inhalation, though no people were injured.

stories.title: Los sindicatos médicos desconvocan la huelga indefinida tras el adelanto electoral del 29-N

en.title: Medical unions call off indefinite strike following early election on 29-N
en.summary: Medical unions have cancelled their planned indefinite strike after parliament was dissolved for early elections. The dissolution halted legislative proceedings on the Framework Statute, which was the main reason for the planned mobilization.

stories.title: Consumo expedienta a un portal inmobiliario y avisa de que vigilará el cumplimiento del nuevo decreto de vivienda

en.title: Consumer Authority files charges against real estate portal and warns it will monitor compliance with new housing decree
en.summary: A consumer protection agency has filed sanctions against a real estate portal and announced monitoring of compliance with new housing regulations. Potential fines could reach 100,000 euros or four to six times the illicit profits obtained.

stories.title: Consumo abre expediente a un gran portal inmobiliario por prácticas desleales contra los usuarios

en.title: Consumer Affairs Opens Investigation Against Major Real Estate Portal for Unfair Practices Against Users
en.summary: Spain's Consumer Ministry has launched an investigation into a large real estate platform operating nationwide for allegedly engaging in unfair commercial practices. The ministry plans to issue guidance to major platforms regarding their obligations under new housing regulations.

stories.title: Consumo expedienta a un gran portal inmobiliario por prácticas comerciales desleales

en.title: Consumer Affairs Investigates Major Real Estate Portal for Unfair Commercial Practices
en.summary: Spain's Ministry of Social Rights, Consumer Affairs and 2030 Agenda has opened a disciplinary proceeding against a national real estate portal over suspected unfair commercial practices against consumers, following a complaint from consumer federation CECU.

stories.title: El nuevo decreto de vivienda obliga a las administraciones a asumir la deuda de inquilinos vulnerables para frenar desahucios

en.title: New Housing Decree Requires Administrations to Assume Vulnerable Tenants' Debt to Prevent Evictions
en.summary: A new housing decree mandates that public administrations assume debt of vulnerable renters to help prevent evictions. The regulation also includes mandatory lease extensions, increased transparency in advertisements, and protections for public housing stock.

stories.title: Caos en Rodalies de Cataluña por el plante de los maquinistas tras el temporal

en.title: Chaos on Catalonia's Rodalies After Train Drivers' Strike Following Storm
en.summary: Train operators in Catalonia experienced significant disruptions after locomotive drivers walked out following severe weather. The operator advised passengers to seek alternative transportation while infrastructure repairs are underway.

en.title: Spotify launches audiobooks in Spain
en.summary: Spotify has introduced a catalog of over 45,000 Spanish-language audiobooks through agreements with publishers and independent authors. Premium subscribers will receive 12 hours of audiobook listening per month.

stories.title: Consum destinará 100 milonea a su segunda plataforma logística de la Zona Franca de Barcelona

en.title: Consum to invest 100 million in second logistics platform in Barcelona's Free Trade Zone
en.summary: Consum will develop a logistics facility with 50,000 square meters on the site of the former Damm brewery in Barcelona's Free Trade Zone.

stories.title: Guía para inquilinos y caseros: así queda regulado el mercado del alquiler desde mañana

en.title: Guide for tenants and landlords: rental market regulation comes into effect tomorrow
en.summary: Spain's Official Gazette is publishing two Royal Decrees on housing that were re-approved by the Council of Ministers, establishing new rental market regulations.

stories.title: El Ibex se frena con el petróleo y la deuda

en.title: Ibex slows amid oil and debt pressures
en.summary: The Ibex index halted a three-day rally as oil prices exceeded 100 dollars per barrel and debt interest rates approached record highs, prompting expectations of further interest rate increases globally.

stories.title: Detenido por traición el exjefe del servicio de inteligencia alemán

en.title: Former German intelligence chief arrested for treason
en.summary: August Hanning, a former director of Germany's foreign intelligence service, has been detained on suspicion of selling state secrets to a foreign power.
